author: Rachel Fortin
subject: Orvane small business program - Meadow Port
body:
Hi Sean,

I'm the Orvane account manager covering small businesses in New Mexico. I noticed Meadow Port is growing quickly and wanted to introduce our small business program - business pricing, ProCare support and a dedicated contact (me).

Would you have 15 minutes next week?

Best,
Rachel Fortin
Account Manager | Orvane Technologies

[No reply. Contact came from a purchased list - title "Network Manager".]

author: Rachel Fortin
subject: Inbound - business account setup
body:
Inbound from web chat - Shane Hayes (co-founder/CTO) wants a business account. Personal care products, manufacturing + DTC e-commerce, Albuquerque. ~60 people, hiring fast.

- Current devices are "a mess" - mix of whatever people brought + some Orvane laptops Shane picked up himself. Didn't ask where from.
- No real IT dept. Shane's brother Thomas handles assets/onboarding part-time.
- Server closet: 2 hosts on vSphere 7, backup software to a NAS.
- Needs: 15-20 laptops over next 6 months for new hires, docks + monitors.

Set up SB account, sent credit app. Next: quote 10x Aster 3 14 + Tether docks. Shane prefers to pay by card for now.

author: Rachel Fortin
subject: Asset review w/ Thomas Hayes
body:
Met Thomas (IT asset mgr, Shane's brother) at their office.
- Inventory spreadsheet: 41 laptops, 12 desktops. ~half Orvane. Some Orvane units aren't in our system under Meadow Port - Thomas thinks "Shane bought those before we had the account". Didn't dig in.
- Planning a second production site next year (new site build-out) - ~40 production floor PCs, small form factor, need to survive dust.
- Want a standard image. Asked about zero-touch deployment - told them it's available on business orders, not consumer ones.
Next: SFF quote for new site, ProCare Basic on all new units.

author: Rachel Fortin
subject: New site order - never came to us
body: Followed up on my new-site quote (Cadence 3 SFF for the production floor + a few Asters, zero-touch included). Shane: "we already bought most of it on the website." Nothing on the Meadow Port account - probably his card on the consumer store again, or a personal account. My quote was cheaper per unit. Asked for order numbers so we can at least link the serials - no reply. I'm off this territory in May, need to hand off cleanly.

author: Jennifer Gagnon
subject: Intro - new AE
body:
Intro call w/ Scott Moore (new Dir IT Procurement). I took over in late June - account had no owner for ~6 weeks.

- Scott said Rachel "promised" a volume discount tier on all future orders. Nothing in notes about that. Told him I'd check.
- Second-site build-out mostly done (bulk of it bought on the online store in Feb).
- Thomas Hayes left in January - Scott didn't know who's handling assets now. Our CRM still lists Thomas as active.
- They're raising money - Scott expects a round next spring. More hiring.

Next: confirm the discount thing with Rachel's old manager. Send Scott a POs-required process doc - they want to start using POs.

author: Jennifer Gagnon
subject: Q4 pricing - Meadow Port
body:
Hi Scott,

As discussed, attached is the Q4 pricing on Aster 3 14 G5 + Clarity monitors. Unfortunately I couldn't find an approved volume tier from Rachel, but I've applied the best SB pricing available.

Best,
Jennifer

---
Undeliverable: scott.moore@meadowportproducts.com - The email account that you tried to reach does not exist.

[Called main line - Scott left in Sept. Got pointed to Priya Holt (storage & backup mgr), she'll take vendor stuff for now.]

author: Grant Barnes
subject: Ransomware resilience - backup discussion
body:
Attendees: Colin Kelly (Storage & Backup Mgr - new hire), Shane Hayes; Grant Barnes

Context: Their insurer is requiring immutable backups at renewal (June). Colin was hired to fix backup.

Current:
- 3 vSphere 7 hosts now (2 at HQ, 1 at new site). ~45TB protected.
- Backup software (Veeam-style competitor product) to a single NAS. No offsite copy, no immutability. Backup window ~8 hrs.
- RPO 24h, wants 4h for ERP + e-commerce order DB. RTO <4h for order DB - "every hour down is lost sales".

Proposal: Vault DP with immutable snapshots as the backup target, keep their backup software for now (Colin doesn't want to change both at once). Second Vault at the new site for replication later.

Decision: Shane signs, needs CFO sign-off (Scott Gray) over $100K. They want POs now - first PO-driven order.

Actions: Grant send quote (Vault DP5900). Colin send capacity report.

author: Grant Barnes
subject: Vault shipped - one PO, one not
body: Vault DP5900 + install booked as SO-30268506 ($109,672, PO 4542665907) - first real PO from them, Scott Gray's team issued it. The follow-on for the second site (SO-30268527, $44,144) went in with no PO - Shane approved by email. No opp on either (I quoted straight off the March meeting and never created one, my miss). Missed the June insurer deadline by 6 weeks - they got an extension. The May funding round is going to edge/IoT at the warehouse.

author: Grant Barnes
subject: Handoff - buying pattern
body: fyi for handoff, my last week on Meadow Port. Their biggest orders keep coming in sideways: $110,223 on the online store in Sept (SO-30268587, card, not linked to anything); Jennifer's Jan '23 order SO-30268191 still shows PO "per John"; SO-30268186 sat on Awaiting PO; second Vault went in with no PO. @Spencer Diaz they buy wherever is fastest, get them on Premier.

author: Shannon Gauthier
subject: Win 11 readiness - found unlinked consumer units
body:
Call w/ Lisa Cole (IT Asset Mgr, started late 2023). Working on Win 11 migration plan.

Lisa ran an Orvane Manage inventory. 6 Orvane serials report in but aren't on the Meadow Port account / have no ProCare. Asked about them - Lisa: "Oh, those are Shane's. He bought the first two Asters on the website with his personal card back in early 2021, before we had a company account. And then some more later the same way, I think." Some are Nova consumer laptops.

Impact:
- Consumer warranty only, no ProCare, no zero-touch / Autopilot registration, can't be managed under their business entitlement.
- Several are on Win10, some (the Novas) aren't on the business Win11 image.
- None of these purchases show on our account history, so our install base and spend for this customer is understated.

Next: ask support whether consumer serials can be moved to the business account. Get list of serials from Lisa.

author: Shannon Gauthier
subject: Win 11 migration - device list
body:
Hi Priya,

Lisa mentioned you still have the 2021 asset spreadsheet from Thomas - attached is the device list with the 6 units we couldn't match to your business account. Could you confirm who should own the decision on whether we replace or re-register those?

Thanks,
Shannon Gauthier
Inside Client Specialist | Orvane Technologies

[Bounced - Priya Holt left end of Feb. Lisa owns it.]

author: Spencer Diaz
subject: Design team order
body: Booked SO-30268903 ($44,658, PO 4554540514) - Aster 5 16 (64GB / 2TB) for the product design + packaging team, docks, Clarity 32s. The March order (SO-30268847) sat on Awaiting PO for two weeks - Lisa says purchasing process is "in flux" again. Discount was above my line, approval pending. Neither is linked to an opp.

author: Jamie Tran
subject: Storage + warehouse network order
body: SO-30268952 ($76,550, PO 4595657401) - Strata 300 G4 for ERP migration staging + Mesh switches for the new warehouse. Colin Nguyen (Network Mgr) driving the warehouse side - scanners, label printers, thin clients on separate VLAN. No opp - order not linked. They're ~300 people per Lisa.

author: Chad Rodriguez
subject: Consumer serials - support answer
body: picked up client seat on Meadow Port (vacant since Sept). Shannon's open item on Shane's consumer-bought units: support says consumer and commercial entitlements can't be merged - each serial needs a ProCare uplift SKU bought separately, and Nova models aren't eligible. Lisa's count is now 4, not 6 (2 retired). Proposing: replace the Novas, uplift the Asters.

author: Spencer Diaz
subject: Segment / firmographics
body: fyi Meadow Port flagged Medium Business for FY25, but our firmographic record still says ~150 employees. Lisa says they're over 300. Consumer purchases from 2021 + online store orders are why their lifetime spend looks small. Opened data ticket.

author: Ananya Patel
subject: Account planning - new AE
body:
Attendees: Shane Hayes (CTO), John Herrera (Dir IT Procurement), Scott Gray (CFO, last 15 min); Ananya Patel (AE since July), Scott Kennedy, Jamie Tran

Intro + planning. Spencer left in June, AE seat empty for a month.

Business: preparing an IPO filing (likely confidential, Nov). ~360 employees across HQ, production site and warehouse. Scott Gray: SOX readiness means asset tracking + purchasing controls have to be clean - "no more card purchases on the website, no more orders without a PO."

Priorities FY26:
- Hybrid work (~120 office staff): Aster 5 13 + Tether docks + Clarity, standard image, zero-touch.
- ERP migration cutover in Q1 (Jamie: Strata 300 KYND2VH is near 90% - needs capacity before cutover; Vault DP2400 9769MB0 close behind).
- Last Win 10 holdouts - mostly Shane's old consumer-bought units.

Partner: Ironclad Data Partners has been selling them storage services + some devices since spring. John likes them for project work.
Competition: Lumora is pitching Scott Gray a desktop-as-a-service offer for the hybrid wave.

Decisions: All purchases go through POs + Premier portal from Sept. Ironclad for services delivery, direct for hardware - John to confirm.

Actions: Scott Kennedy hybrid work quote. Jamie Strata expansion sizing. Ananya clean up contacts (Thomas Hayes, Scott Moore, Priya Holt, Sean Kelly all still active in CRM).

author: Ananya Patel
subject: Ironclad duplicate registration
body: @Scott Kennedy Ironclad registered the same hybrid work deal we have as 0065f00004iL5OlAAK. Their order SO-30269203 ($49,293) came in 10/20 with no end-user contact - Lisa thought she was buying from us. Our direct wave 1 order SO-30269201 ($53,423) shipped 10/6, and SO-30269248 ($48,077) just went in with PO "N/A" - need the real number. Customer is confused who to buy from. Also they filed confidentially for IPO yesterday - Scott Gray will be locking down vendor lists.

author: Ananya Patel
subject: Invoice questions - multiple payments
body:
Hi Ananya,

We're cleaning up our AP ledger for year-end audit. A few questions:

1. We have 2 payments to Orvane in December that your remittance team shows as "unapplied." Can you tell me which invoices they should go against? Payment refs attached.
2. Several invoices from Ironclad Data Partners reference Orvane equipment but don't have our PO numbers on them. Our auditors are asking.
3. Is there a way to get one statement for everything we've bought from Orvane, including the older purchases Shane made on the website? Lisa says those don't show on our account.

Thanks,
Elizabeth Lindqvist
AP Specialist, Meadow Port Products L.P.

author: Andrew Powell
subject: ProCare uplift + ITAD scope
body:
Scoping two services items for FY27 Q1, no opps yet (Ananya wants them on one services opp):
- ProCare Plus uplift for the remaining Asters Shane bought on the consumer site in 2021 + older SB units, so they're under one entitlement for the SOX asset audit.
- ITAD + data sanitization for the Novas and last Win10 units being retired, certificates per serial (auditors want them).
SO-30269266 ($22,676, PO 4533381609) in Dec was deployment services for hybrid wave 1. Lisa is the decision maker on both; John Herrera signs.

author: Scott Kennedy
subject: Account summary for FY27 planning
body:
Summary for whoever needs it (this account has changed hands a lot):
- Started as founder Shane Hayes buying laptops on our consumer web store with his personal card in early 2021 (2 orders, ~5 units incl. Nova consumer models - Lisa's list differs). Those were never linked to the business account, and the 2022 new-site gear may have gone the same way. SB account opened Apr 2021, MB from FY25. Now ~363 employees (firmographics say 230), filed confidentially for IPO in Nov 2025.
- Install: 57 Wisp 3000 thin clients (production/warehouse), ~61 Cadence 5 Tower, 25 Cadence 3 SFF G5, ~56 Aster 3 15 G4/G5, ~93 Aster 5 (13/14/16), 12 high-end GPU (48GB) workstations for design. Vault DP2400 x2 + DP5900 (9769MB0 at 82.8%), Strata 300 x3 - KYND2VH at 93%, needs action now. 29 open security advisories (3 risk accepted).
- Buying behavior: historically card/online store, now PO + Premier only (SOX) - though 1/27 order SO-30269348 still sat on Awaiting PO. Ironclad Data Partners active, overlapping registrations. Lumora pitching DaaS.
- Open: 4 client devices opps (hybrid work waves), Mesh refresh 0065f00004iLBJpAAO ($61,596), Manage/Shield software 0065f00004iLEOEAA4 ($30,371) + 0065f00004iL3txAAC.
